messages:
marta: Heads-up — bringing up hf/llama-3-70b-int8 on rw conversion. Seeing function-call stubs collapse: tool tags are injected as \"<tool::name>\" but our JSON-mode sentinel is \"<JSON_START>\" in some HF chat templates. Need a quick checklist before the quant runs.

leo: Got a repro? paste a minimal example and I'll try to run it locally.

marta: Minimal repro inline:
```
User: \"call_tool:weather\"
Assistant (toolcall role): \"<tool::weather>{\"zip\":95014}</tool::weather>\"
```
After tokenization the inner JSON gets split around the \"{\" and the closing tool tag gets tokenized into two pieces so model outputs end up with malformed JSON.

dina: Sounds like an additional_special_tokens mismatch during conversion. HF tokenizer usually has \"additional_special_tokens\": [\"<tool::weather>\", \"</tool::weather>\", \"<JSON_START>\", \"<JSON_END>\"] but our converted tokenizer/config dropped the closing tags for some models.

benchbot: quick benchmark: token_split_regression on 5000 prompts -> 12% toolcall outputs truncated or with broken JSON. Full log: https://bench.example/1234 (summary attached). :chart_with_upwards_trend:

leo: Quick fixes to try:
- ensure convert_tokenizer.py preserves additional_special_tokens and writes tokenizer.json
- set tokenizer.sep_token/eos_token explicitly when missing
- map HF chat template role tokens to rw_role_tokens in the model metadata

marta: Also an oddity: the quantize step (q8_0) can renumber token ids unless we preserve special tokens. If token ids shift, those additional_special_tokens point to wrong ids and the tokenizer emits placeholders. We should add --preserve-specials to the remap flow.

dina: Proposed checklist to add to onboarding docs:
1) export HF tokenizer (tokenizer.json + merges/vocab)
2) verify additional_special_tokens roundtrip (opening and closing tags)
3) convert config.json chat template role names -> rw_role_tokens mapping (system/user/assistant)
4) run token-id diff and remap with --preserve-specials flag
5) run benchbot subset (toolcall-heavy prompts) and check token-split/regression metrics
I'll open a PR with the checklist and a tiny conversion script snippet.

leo: @marta can you attach a tiny failing prompt to the PR? something with nested JSON and emoji to be thorough (eg: \"call_tool:translate\" with payload {\"text\":\"I love ☕️\"}).

marta: Yup — adding a failing prompt and expected output, plus a conversion unit test.

infra-bot: deploy preview for branch hf-tool-sentinels: SUCCESS — integration test suite 234/234 passed. :white_check_mark:

marta: Awesome, once PR merges we'll re-run the quant sweep and bench subset. If anyone wants to pair on the tokenizer edgecases tomorrow ping me. :wave:
